notes.title: September Major Update
notes.content: [p]Hello everyone ![/p][p][/p][p]Glad to say the update is here, and I'd like to start by reminding you :[/p][p][/p][list][*][p][b]Don't use your old saves, they won't work anymore ! All game systems have been modified; you'll have to start a new game.[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Check in Options if you have 120 FPS or unlimited by default.[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Do not activate vertical synchronization, it is not fully functional ![/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]If you're streaming/recording for YouTube/Twitch, disable music; I don't have the required licenses to allow this.[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]If you have problems saving, or the J key isn't working (to activate the mission list), delete everything in the game's save folder (user > appdata > LocalLow > RemnantGames). You can also access the mission bar from the inventory[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]If you can't find the new missions, slide the scroll bar just to the right of the list or click on the Act 2 tab[/b][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]The update transforms the way you approach levels. You're now in bases that will serve to prepare you for "expeditions," in the form of missions that you can launch at your leisure from a list. You unlock them by talking to certain characters, completing other missions, etc.[/p][p]You can return to the missions as often as you like. To complete them, you must complete the first objective that appears. The other two levels are secondary but increase your reward.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42516414/257915be25327c6e61a6874625ed5362eb70c80a.png"][/img][/p][p]With the gold earned, once you return to base, you can buy and unlock different upgrades, the best weapons/care/armor unlocks as you make purchases. Be careful, there is a first base price for some consumables, for example to unlock the doctor's kit you have to pay more gold (unlock) before paying with the price stated above.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42516414/a63df076e2f3361d2fac5fb7e1bf18d23e8dca4b.png"][/img][/p][p]Important detail, everything you make in the base is automatically restocked once you return from a mission, however not everything found in a mission (weapon, consumables) is available in the base, it's a bit confusing but it's a system that I thought was simple to effectively think about the overall economy of the game, because in the future the missions will have particularities in terms of loot.[/p][p]I will improve this system in the future because I realize now that it is a little frustrating to collect lots of items for nothing and encourages less exploration.[/p][p]I have changed a lot of the levels that you knew at the release of early access, and added new ones, but the story has not yet changed, now I will tackle the continuation of the latter and I will also approach the influencers because the release 3 months ago went unnoticed and I took the opportunity to correct the bugs and make improvements.[/p][p]You will notice that you will now spend a little more time at the starting base, I thought it would be nice to have a sort of tutorial prologue that shows a little of the mechanics before embarking on the big expedition. The missions are currently quite short, but as you unlock them, the duration and challenge will increase.[/p][p]I will also be more present on the networks to show the progress of the future content, and to do a little advertising on occasion, I can't wait to start chapter 2, there will be a variety of environments and levels, and the story will be really fun.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42516414/413f88958f49974d22d7ec64cf1bb6c3b48a1b34.png"][/img][/p][p][b]                                                          Let's go for the creation of part 2[/b][/p][p][/p][p]I was able to fix a good list of bugs from the early access release, unfortunately there are still a few left, and one of the most annoying is that sometimes shots go through enemies, and this happens especially if you have few FPS in the game, in fact, it's a raycast problem due to the basic shooting system, and I'll have to completely change the ballistics, I decided to do that next time because I didn't want to postpone the update again. also in the future, the saves will be compatible with the next updates, sorry to make you start the adventure again, but there it was really complicated to re-adapt everything.[/p][p]The next content update is planned for the beginning of the year, by mid-January/February. For the most curious and impatient, you can check my Instagram and Twitter to discover leaks of future levels. Thanks again to everyone who has supported me since the beginning, to all the beta testers of the update and to my programmer Damien Delhaye who did a hell of a job to implement all these colossal changes.[/p][p][/p][p]I hope you enjoy the new experience, please let me know what you think on the Steam or Discord hub ![/p][p][/p][p]Syd[/p]

notes.title: July Devlog
notes.content: [p]Hello everyone! I hope you're having a great summer. [/p][p][/p][p]I'm taking advantage of the end of July to share some news about the upcoming major update.[/p][p]And "major update" is an understatement. It's going to be a complete change to the overall gameplay. I'll tell you all about it in detail.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42516414/071db60b334f316695deff66ca13f9f089e974b8.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Keeping up the pace of work, but[/b][/p][p][b] sometimes the cat gets his balls on the mouse.[/b][/p][p][/p][p]The main concern after the feedback from the early access release was optimization and bug fixing. After several hours of work, I ended up having to shorten the levels I had created. I actually use an asset (umodeler) that allows me to model the levels very quickly. However, this requires considerable performance if these models are present in the scene, in any way, whether with an aggressive LOD, occlusion everywhere, or deactivation. The only reliable and simple solution was to halve the maps to achieve decent performance. I can find other ways to optimize, but this was the fastest because I want to be able to deliver my early access updates on time.[/p][p][/p][p]The second concern was game design. Since I shrunk the majority of my levels, an idea had started to germinate in my head, what if I made an expedition system to go directly to these places ? like that I could create levels very easily at will with freedom of creativity without the problem of the open world. In addition, I could put various different objectives or even mini games in these levels.[/p][p]So, instead of working on the perk system, I developed a whole new "mission" system with my freelance programmer, similar to games like Metal Gear Solid 5 and Warface. We have "hub" areas with quest givers and merchants, and we go through levels that will offer specific objectives. The unique feature is that we'll have several missions with various modes (race, elimination, extraction, defense), as well as missions that follow the main quest.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42516414/69daf028f66aa72957437029adb34f8ab6d5d744.png"][/img][/p][p][b]                              The explorators villages will serve as expedition points[/b][/p][p]                                                       [/p][p]I'm completely changing the entire structure of the game, the menus, the saves, the levels, and it's going to take me all of next month, but I'm pretty confident because, on the one hand, the levels will now be easier to optimize/work on, and on the other hand, I think it'll make the game even more fun. I can have fun building any type of setting without having to follow the narrative design of my basic structure. I also took the opportunity to add challenges to the missions (like finishing the mission within a given time limit). For the more hardcore players who want to challenge themselves more, in the future, I'm also thinking about creating modes that could be played endlessly with gradual difficulty, like Survivors.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42516414/19aa21ed15c6353a108bb66410a1850e6e1927fc.png"][/img][/p][p][b]                                                 The levels will offer more verticality[/b][/p][p][/p][p]To complement this, there will be a "crafting" system instead of the merchant. In fact, as we complete missions, we'll be able to unlock items that can be upgraded as we unlock the next levels. I find this progression system fun, which would go hand in hand with the mission system. We'll be able to prioritize unlocking items that suit our playstyle (light armor, heavy weapons, special grenades, etc.).[/p][p][/p][p]Normally, I could release this update by September. By the time we can test/balance everything, you'll have to start the adventure again, but believe me, you won't regret it. All the areas have been redone, and I've learned from the level design mistakes. There will be much more verticality and dynamism, especially since I've been able to add more detail to my levels since I reduced their size.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42516414/a7f4dd03bca7dd954f8e3a7e1e1d89bfc71d69b0.png"][/img][/p][p]                                   [b]The levels will be smaller but will have more details[/b][/p][p][/p][p]On the other hand, I want to warn you that the perk system is still in the forefront. Once I've implemented the big mission feature, I want to make the experience even more light RPG-like, so you'll want to replay the missions in several play styles! I also plan to add new enemies, but I don't know if I'll have time by September. In any case, expect to see lots of new, unique levels ![/p][p][/p][p]By the way, I'd like to point out that I've improved the "visibility" in the levels quite a bit. I noticed that on some screens, the contrast was really poorly calibrated, and that on other screens everything was really dark, which many people have pointed out. It should be much better soon. (Keep in mind that I have planned missions specifically so that we are plunged into total darkness.)[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42516414/5bf8a3f4f50203afc04ff86814bfc47540cf3c67.png"][/img][/p][p][b]                                                 Reworked many places that were too dark[/b][/p][p][/p][p]I thank those who purchased a copy of the game and supported its development. It might not seem like it, but every purchase was essential for me to work on the update, otherwise I would have scaled back my ambitions.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]Have a great summer ![/p][p][/p][p]Sydney[/p]

notes.title: Optimization Update
notes.content: [p]Level optimization update, batches have been significantly reduced and LODS (levels of detail) added for some objects.[/p][p]I hope it will work better on a lot of configurations. There's still a lot of work to be done on it, but it's a good start to relieve the CPU load.[/p][p]The next update will focus on gameplay overhaul, with promises of adding enemies, quests, and skills in the first part. I'll also fix the most important bugs.[/p][p][/p][p]Thanks for the early access support ![/p][p][/p][p]Sydney[/p]

notes.title: Fixes & Devlog
notes.content: [p]Hello there !![/p][p]Sorry for being so late for providing the first fix. I tried to fix other issues and couldn't resolve them. I wanted to update everything at once, and other issues appeared after fixing them. My main concern was to optimize the levels as much as possible. I tested several assets to combine scenery elements and improve FPS. I also exported a copy of the project to Unity 2024 to test the new optimization features. However, it's something that requires time. When i have finished the first chapter and what i promised in it, i will see if i can export everything without too much damage in the latest unity version.[/p][p]WARNING: I added Vsync to the options, but the game stutters a lot. I don't recommend enabling it. I'm currently looking for a way to fix this.[/p][p][/p][p]- Fixed the issue where some effect sounds remained despite the reduced volume.[/p][p]- Changed the noise distance of some effect sounds.[/p][p]- Added the ability to press to run.[/p][p]- Added more ammo to find in levels.[/p][p]- Fixed the issue where ranged enemies remained static when we were far away.[/p][p]- Added an animation on revolver-type weapons.[/p][p]- Reduced particle effects to improve performance.[/p][p]- Added a warning when the game saves.[/p][p]- Fixed the issue where enemies no longer attacked us when we were lying down.[/p][p]- Fixed some enemies that remained dark in the light.[/p][p]- You can now run while crouching[/p][p][/p][p] ------- Issues still unresolved. ----------[/p][p][/p][p]- UI issue (abnormal inventory/merchant sizes).[/p][p]- Performance issue on some Configuration[/p][p]- Player animation stuttering issue[/p][p]- Vsync issue [/p][p]- The character gets stuck on the ground if you crouch[/p][p][/p][p]It seems some people forget to click "apply" when making a change to the options. In the next update, I'll add a warning that the changes aren't saved.[/p][p]I'll try to fix the bugs mentioned above and continue to optimize the game. However, I'm preparing for the upcoming game content next month. As planned, I'd like to add side quests with new locations in the capital, the abyss, and the forest. Add new items and additional lore to locations.[/p][p]You will also notice that some places are emptier than before, I had to remove the obstacle FX which took too much resources, instead I will put new dungeons to discover.[/p][p][/p][p]                         [b]A place that will be familiar to those who played the demo last year[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42516414/ec68332cff18aad9e98af9117f3512d97e23f73f.png"][/img][/p][p]              [/p][p]Thank you again for supporting me and purchasing an early access copy ![/p][p][/p][p]Syd[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Early Access Devlog & Roadmap
notes.content: [p]Hello Explorators ! [/p][p]Last Saturday was a moment of intense emotion with the release of early access. I'm glad it went off without too much damage, so I'm going to tell you what's next for the game after its launch. Thanks again to the Future Game Show for being able to make the announcement, it was super cool of them and the event was amazing ![/p][p][/p][p]Firstly, the number one priority is bug fixes and optimizations. I think the main reason for the latter is the cost, in particular, of my FX. I'm going to try to optimize that as much as possible.[/p][p]Here I'm posting the fixes I'm going to make to address these issues :[/p][p][/p][list][*][p]GPU performance issue[/p][/*][*][p] Saves that keep scrolling on the load menu[/p][/*][*][p]Problems in aiming mode with scopes[/p][/*][*][p]Jittery animation when jumping[/p][/*][*][p]When crouching/lying down, you can no longer get up[/p][/*][*][p]Problem with some sounds being too loud and heard over long distances, and not being taken into account by the options[/p][/*][*][p]Character deceleration problem (feeling of being on roller skates)[/p][/*][*][p]Missing an option to disable mouse acceleration[/p][/*][*][p]very dark enemies in the abyss[/p][/*][*][p]Minimap icon problems[/p][/*][*][p]problem scrolling through journal/codex quests[/p][/*][*][p]Have the ability to press once to activate sprint[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]There are probably still many other bugs but these are the ones I have encountered so far, if you have discovered the slightest problem do not hesitate to mention it to me on steam or on discord. Thanks in advance for this.[/p][p][/p][p]Now let's talk about the future content of the game ![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42516414/8a08af94740603ac0752f4d68594f9e5cf68440d.png"][/img][/p][p]The Explorator is a shooting and exploration game in a poetic and violent universe. The final content will offer around 8 hours of gameplay. Early access will be in 3 parts. The first part is not yet finished but offers at least 2 hours of play.[/p][p]The update I would do first is to fill the levels with lore and new objects to collect, as well as new small places that will appear little by little. I have planned a level to explore in the Capital village. Another level in the abandoned city, and why not expand the beach level with caves to explore under the dunes.[/p][p]The big system I have planned for the future is the ability to obtain permanent improvements by collecting crystals scattered throughout the levels. [/p][p]For example, they will allow you to improve your health, regeneration, improve your weapons or your jetpack, and even why not have a companion (currently being tested)[/p][p]Those who have gone to the end of the adventure will have passed the blue abyss, this place is under construction, it will soon be filled with quests, obstacles, enemies and elements to find. As well as access to the old village.[/p][p][/p][p]Speaking of the jetpack, I'm also going to rework the abandoned city level because we have the possibility to pass over the buildings, I'm going to add interesting things to find and finish the incomplete level design.[/p][p]In summary, I will try to finish the content here and add it at the nesxt month, with a bit of luck I will also have the perk system working.[/p][p][/p][p]Thanks again to those who support me, don't hesitate to share your opinions with me on Discord or on the Steam discussion.[/p][p][/p][p]Sydney[/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Devlog March 2025
notes.content:
Hello everyone !

It's been a while since the last devlog in December. I hope you're all well.
I'd like to take this opportunity to wish you a Happy New Year (it's never too late).  I'm going to do a quick summary of what happened previously.

Last Year, I tried to do a kickstarter which unfortunately failed, and I also regret to announce that I did not find a publisher either, ( I think they do not realize yet the ambition of the project è__é ). I did my best but the main problem that came up was that they preferred to edit a game that did not rely on freelancers. In fact, I started the project alone and I currently use a freelancer for everything that is programming, and sometimes colleagues who help me to make magnificent animations or 3D models. The project was initially able to start thanks to the help of my brother who financed it and who manages everything administrative/accounting.

I still had to revise things downwards, but early access is still planned for this summer, I will try my best to make it as good as possible.

by the end of April I will offer those who wish to test an alpha, this will allow me to have feedback and to correct/add features. To be informed about this, I invite you to join my Discord, where I regularly post progress on the project : https://discord.gg/RPbeAk3CcQ


Oh and on Twitter too I post a lot of little things : https://x.com/Sydnus83


Early access will be half of the first chapter (three chapters in total in the final game). I don't know how long it will be yet, but there will be side quests and you'll be able to explore the world of The Explorator in several paths (semi-open areas).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42516414/159b834f7b7404a08ef2d3e41e9ee364695a2584.png[/img]
[b]I completely redid the forest and beach levels from the old demos to make them look more natural and semi-open[/b]

Initially planned as a frenetic doom-like, The Explorator has become an atmospheric shooter, inspired by Stalker, E.Y.E. Divine Cybermancy, and The Long Dark. You'll explore majestic and immersive locations while being on the lookout for the constantly lurking danger. I hope you enjoy this new direction. I also took the opportunity to remove the demo, which no longer fits the game's new vision. you will be transported to the beauty of Ospolis Island which is matched only by its danger. There will be many various encounters on your way, from fearsome militarized goblins to phantasmagorical creatures, environmental elements such as burning geyzer pits or immense toxic ooze.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42516414/0ced083269549c6d4827cec70c985db5081ef7dc.png[/img]

Having quality equipment will be essential if you hope to cross the most remote areas. You can acquire it by searching enemy bases, gathering resources to craft them, or purchasing them from vendors. The crafting system will allow you to create new and improved equipment, you will always be able to buy what you are missing from merchants in exchange for a higher cost.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42516414/fc4c54af6947010ce5e6ccdf06f17b95a86703cc.png[/img]
[b]A pleasure village of Explorator, you will be able to stock up on logistics and information[/b]


There will be walking sim and light RPG elements, there's still the stalker-inspired inventory system, you'll have a wide range of equipment to choose from and upgrade, and lots of information to gather from Explorators and locations that you can consult in your codex and quest log. Storytelling will become a major component of the project, there will be a lot of writing to do and edit, but I will strive to make it exciting to discover. I also wanted to implement more survival mechanisms like item durability or bleeding, but that will have to come later in early access. There will also be additions of new enemies or even new quests planned in the already existing levels.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42516414/7510120a54e1e185c95223ce6a6c03607cbb39f7.png[/img]
[b]A short moment of relaxation in an Atlantean cathedral[/b]


My goal this year would be to properly launch early access this summer and set a sales figure of 3,000 by the end of the year. This would allow me to properly continue early access. If I'm lucky enough to exceed this figure, I could help myself with new talented freelancers and add more features and quality to the overall production, whether it's animations, sets, writing. In any case, I will continue to work on the rest of the chapters. I plan to sell the early access for around fifteen euros, and the price will increase as new chapters arrive.

I'll do what's necessary to advertise on social media and through influencers. By the way, I wanted to ask you if you had a good contact list of influencers/youtubers/streamers who would be interested in playing the game, to be honest I don't know many and I thank you warmly in advance for any information !

To properly prepare for the launch, I'm putting together a trailer that will be exciting (I hope). It will also be very different from the last trailers I've made. It'll be a bit of a surprise for those who have been following the project from the beginning.

I'll launch early access at the same time as the trailer. I'm currently looking for an event in June-July to launch the trailer; that would be ideal.

Thanks again to those who are still following me on this adventure. I'll keep you updated just before the early access release.


Sydney

notes.title: Devlog December
notes.content:
hello there !

It's been a while since we've given any news, we're going to take advantage of it now to talk to you a little bit about everything in detail, I hope you'll be interested.

Our last news goes back to the kickstarter, and as you have seen, it failed and it was a breaking point. We believe in it and unfortunately we had to review all our plans since then, abandon many things if we still wanted to continue the project, so we are going to tell you about the future of the game.

[h3]WHAT IS THE EXPLORATOR ?[/h3]

The Explorator is a game focused on the search for resources and action, we will explore the levels to constantly improve our character, in order to be able to advance by confronting monsters and the scenery the more the player ventures in the depths, and the more the levels will be large, dangerous and obscure but with precious resources.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42516414/405136caf005cc1a30c04bb9a906b40b016aabde.png[/img]
             the levels will be semi-open non-linear areas

The game was originally intended to be an action-oriented Doom-like, but in the end a very good majority of people wanted to take the title of the game literally and that's why we put the focus on the exploration side, to give meaning to this concept, you will have to scour every corner of the environment for valuable resources and thus survive the following levels. You will meet NPCs in the levels who can help you, talk about lore and trade, some can even show you secret places to explore, curiosity is rewarded with unique resources and events.

immediately in the game we will have access to a panel of improvements of several kinds, weaponry, armor, combat capabilities, movement, assistance in exploiting resources (such as sonars) or detecting danger, you will be free to improve / build according to your style of play, but some equipment will be essential to explore the abysses (like a jetpack which allows to reach inaccessible points)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42516414/159b834f7b7404a08ef2d3e41e9ee364695a2584.png[/img]
Allied bases will allow you to obtain information, build and improve equipment

What we want for The Explorator is really a feeling of evolution both in the gameplay and in the visuals, the more you delve into the abyss, the more you will have access to advanced technology and incredible settings. In terms of inspiration, we could say that it's like a mix of subnautica and shooters, with a side of strangeness (e.y.e divine cybermancy for those in the know) The most notable change will be that humor has been put aside for a more atmospheric, sometimes even horrific aspect (the abysses will sometimes be very dark and the creatures that roam are not very friendly)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42516414/c3f5b155d150fa6d3b78e4211f71414163b95654.png[/img]

The deeper you sink into the abyss, the more likely you are to lose yourself in madness and despair.
You'll have to be careful where you step, as the levels will be full of creatures, huge doom zones, and environmental hazards like molten lava, storms, and tornadoes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42516414/e88ae6deb6a5eb2c6c0c29cb90259c7584264eae.png[/img]

The first levels of early access take place mainly outside, but the following chapters will make you explore the depths which will present a verticality in the levels, it will then be essential to find your way by placing beacons, we do not want to give an experience that is too difficult, it will be possible to make a quick trip to the last base to resupply.


[h3]WHAT IS PLANNED FOR 2025
[/h3]

As we told in the kickstarter, we had planned to make an early access that will be released around summer 2025. The early access will be divided into 3 parts, and each will update a major part of the scenario and levels, (like chapters) unfortunately because of the lack of budget we will have to cut a lot of things to be able to release the beginning of the early access until we can finance the rest of the features, there will be a lot of feedback and fixes to be made on the entirety of the early access to have a fully satisfactory experience, that's why we will be very attentive and present to make corrections and modifications during the entire period of the early access.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42516414/fb52b964b5f11cc194ad6edb11c4738b14aa36cd.png[/img]

Thanks to everyone who helps us from discord and the steam forum, it's vital for us because we have no outside help for the moment. Nevertheless, maybe soon we could find the help of a publisher to give us a boost to the project, and why not adapt the game on Xbox Series S/X and PS5 consoles.

to conclude, we hope to be able to release an early access without too much damage by mid-2025 and in the hope that it works, that it can help us finance the development of the game to have the quality that we dreamed of obtaining if the means allow it

thanks again for reading this devlog, and we will keep you informed soon, because we will probably do a closed beta of the early access to spot bugs and problems before its release

see you soon !

[b]Remnant Games Studio
[/b]

You are now in the great forest of ospolis, where we will have to delve deeper into the mystery and danger, the game is more focused on exploration and you will have to help yourself with the compass, your map and environments around you to help you find your way while paying attention to the danger lurking nearby

[b]-------------------------------------- WHAT'S NEXT ? -------------------------------------[/b]


As we said in the previous devlog, we therefore focused on the immersive aspect of the game and focused the gameplay on exploration, we think that we could really find something enriching in giving the player a feeling of finding yourself lost in a magical and mysterious world, which leaves us surprised at every street corner.

We also improved the AI, some ranged enemies now take cover, this is still being improved because we also thought about a system where the enemy could bypass us but there were still problems with it and we are still working on it.

We also plan to enrich the gameplay with light rpg components, we are thinking of a talent tree, unique objects and a crafting system to further encourage the player to explore.

The most important thing for us is to enrich the lore of the game, we are working on writing the story to offer you a unique and ambitious experience unlike the initial project, expect to discover a scenario rich in characters, twists and turns and emotional sequences, we are excited to really give a unique identity to the project by what it tells in its environment, story and quests.

The environments of the new demo are twice as big as the old demo, and we are thinking of expanding the territories even further, we really want to give that feeling of perdition and reward when we discover something new

In the end, development was rather slow at the start of the year, we had to rethink everything to offer a new formula, and in the absence of a publisher and financing, we were unable to get help from outside. , despite everything we remain extremely motivated because the latest feedback has been encouraging and seems to support this change in gameplay.

We hope that the next fest will allow us to have a certain visibility, because we are preparing behind a kickstarter page, if the latter works, we will then be able to speed things up and think bigger, early access is still planned for the next year.

Thank you again for everyone who supports us in this project and do not hesitate to share the new demo with your contacts

bye !!!

notes.title: Devlog #1
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=AucbY_BUvD8;full][/previewyoutube]

Hi Folks !

We would like to first of all thank everyone who gave their opinions and reviews on the steam hub when the demo was released in October, it was really great and we took all the comments into account, some of them were very detailed and it was really great they did this. We want to thank the influencers and journalists who talked about the game, it was really cool too, so thanks to them.

Thus, after a long period of studying the comments and demo reviews, we are going to make quite a few changes for the future

Originally, The Explorator was planned as a doom like parody, with action frenzy and plenty of jokes, but eventually we noticed in our feedback, many wanted to see more depth in the visuals, the narration and the story.  As for us, we wanted to create a more realistic experience, sometimes contemplative. We had made the mistake of designing levels that were too big, but people really enjoyed exploring these large areas and would like that not to change. We said to ourselves that it could become a main component of the game, and give more meaning to our title : The Explorator

This is why in the future, the game will be more of a walking sim, we will have to travel large areas, and we will have to scavenge around for equipment. Exploration will be rewarded with the discovery of sanctuaries or caves which will provide us with special objects, such as relics or unique items. We really want the player to feel lost in this environment, where he will have to use a simple map and clues to find his way through the elements of the background, he can also use objects to guide himself and there may be side quests given by the explorators scattered all over the island.

There will be a profound overhaul of the AI ​​which was initially supposed to be basic to allow the display of as many opponents as possible in very doom-like levels. In the future, soldiers will be evolved enough to hide, to bypass us. the same goes for creatures who can make surprise attacks by circling around us. Obviously, a more advanced AI will be more demanding, especially as the levels grow bigger, there will be fewer enemies but they will be much more dangerous, it will be essential to prepare well before setting off to explore a new area, We hope that in this regard things will work out  because optimization is the main challenge of game development, the graphics style uses up a lot of resources and We will certainly have to make sacrifices to balance all that.

The story will become an important component of the game in the future, initially the script was a simple parody without real depth, but now We want to give real meaning to the search for the city of 'Atlantis. In the course of the adventure we will get to know more about the story behind this city and the characters, places, always with a good sense of humor and beautiful art direction.

We were happy about the soundtracks because people really liked the ones in the demo, We bought licenses from two music sites, audionetwork and epidemic, this allows us to quickly install music that can match perfectly. We found some great ones that can provide a unique immersive adventure experience, as well as ambient and fx sounds to make the places more believable

In the gameplay of the demo, we were not satisfied with the way some of the animations had been done. Given that the game is a shooter, the animations of the characters/creatures are often distant, and in the end we can't really take full advantage of the 2D animations, either because there is too much detail or because they are too small, so, there will be larger creatures to encounter, depending on the depth of the level.

We plan to release the game in early access by the end of the year, and the game will be divided into 3 chapters, this will allow us to improve the game and correct it gradually, thanks to feedback, and to fund the next chapters. Nonetheless We are going to release a kickstarter in the summer because We need funds to allow us to make the new changes and purchase new soundtracks, We will perhaps take advantage of next summer’s steam fest to release a new demo which will present this new vision of the game and also improve our prospects to raise money.

here is a summary of the important points. We hope that these changes will please you. We also hope that we won’t have any problems because these modifications and additions are quite ambitious and require additional time and patience which will be necessary to meet our quality standards but We think it is the best thing to do to improve the game

Thank you very much for watching this devlog. We will keep you informed on Twitter, Steam and Youtube, do not hesitate to register on the discord, and if you are excited about the game, you can register now on the pre launch kickstarter page, 

bye !
